source_evidence: the investor can have the dividends or distributions reinvested in the mutual fund to buy more shares.
answer: When a mutual fund pays dividends or distributes capital gains, you can generally choose to receive the amount or have it reinvested. Reinvesting means using that amount to buy more shares of the mutual fund instead of transferring the money to you. The fund’s distributions can change, and reinvesting does not guarantee that your investment will increase in value.
